sender: Shibuya City Office, Tax Division, Collection Section (渋谷区 区民部 税務課 収納係)
summary: This is a payment reminder (督促状). The 2nd instalment of your fiscal 2026 resident tax, 24,500 yen, was due on August 31, 2026 and has not been paid. Pay it by September 25, 2026.

actions.title: Pay the overdue 2nd instalment of resident tax
how: Pay with the enclosed payment slip at a bank, convenience store, or the Shibuya City Office tax counter
If paying is difficult, contact the Collection Section before the deadline to ask about paying in parts

consequences.text: Late fees are added from the day after the original deadline: 2.4% per year for the first month, then 8.7% per year. The amount will be sent to you later.
If you do not pay by the deadline, the city may seize property such as your salary or bank savings under the Local Tax Act.

source.text: 指定期限までに納付がない場合は、

glossary.meaning: new deadline set in this reminder

warnings: If you already paid, you can ignore this reminder (the letters crossed in the mail).
